at 2026-07-29T12:00:00Z

# Fresh initialization normalizes the selected project directory basename,
# limits the prefix to 16 characters, and persists it at project scope.
mkdir '1234__An Extremely Long Project'
cd '1234__An Extremely Long Project'
exec git init -b main
exec card --json init
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/normalized-init.json
exec card --json config show
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/normalized-effective.json
exec card --json config show --scope project
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/normalized-project.json
cd ..

# A basename without usable prefix characters falls back to cm- at project
# scope.
mkdir ./---___
cd ./---___
exec git init -b main
exec card --json init
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/fallback-init.json
exec card --json config show
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/fallback-effective.json
cd ..

# An active store prefix suppresses basename inference and remains the reported
# store-owned effective value.
mkdir inherited-project
cd inherited-project
exec git init -b main
mkdir .cardamom
cp $WORK/golden/inherited-config.yaml .cardamom/config.yaml
exec card --json init
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/inherited-init.json
exec card --json config show
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/inherited-effective.json
exec card --json config show --scope project
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/inherited-project.json
cd ..

# An explicit prefix is a project override even when initialization creates
# config.yaml.
mkdir explicit-project
cd explicit-project
exec git init -b main
exec card --json init --prefix explicit-
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/explicit-init.json
cmp .cardamom/config.yaml $WORK/golden/default-config.yaml
exec card --json config show
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/explicit-effective.json
exec card --json config show --scope project
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/explicit-project.json
cd ..

# Repeated initialization from another project directory neither infers nor
# mutates a retained project prefix. An explicit prefix still updates it.
mkdir retained-alpha
mkdir retained-beta
mkdir retained-store
cd retained-alpha
exec card --store ../retained-store --json init
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/retained-first-init.json
cd ../retained-beta
exec card --store ../retained-store --json init
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/retained-repeat-init.json
exec card --store ../retained-store --json config show
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/retained-effective.json
exec card --store ../retained-store --json init --prefix chosen-
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/retained-explicit-init.json
exec card --store ../retained-store --json config show
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/retained-explicit-effective.json

# Help describes inferred defaults, store inheritance, and project ownership.
exec card init --help
stdout 'basename'
stdout 'active store prefix'
stdout 'project-level override'

-- golden/default-config.yaml --
# config.yaml contains local overrides for this physical Cardamom store.
# Missing or commented values inherit built-in, project, or board values.
# Use card config set --scope store KEY VALUE to set one value.
# Use card config unset --scope store KEY to restore inheritance.
